title: SpellCore Focus: Integrations
summary: Connect SpellCore to RitualCore, Arcane Index, Grimoire, MissionCore, and future curse rules.

blocks.title: Connected Systems
blocks.body: RitualCore can awaken spell cores, Arcane Index publishes spell pages, Grimoire explains risks, and MissionCore records starter casts.

blocks.title: Practical Pairings
blocks.body: Use Index for spell facts, Grimoire for warning context, RitualCore for awakened cores, and Lens or HoloMap when future spells affect field state.

blocks.title: Fallback Play
blocks.body: If optional RitualCore is absent, keep the focus loop readable and report which requirement changed in the loaded addon set.

blocks.title: Fallback Check
blocks.body: If the helper addon is absent, keep the same order by hand and follow the manual checkpoint.
